turns.question: where are we losing ppl in the funnel? biggest drop-off?
turns.answer:
**Biggest single drop-off: 515 confirmed registrants who never showed up** — 20.6% of the 2,500 confirmed, as of 20 Apr 2025 (all campaigns combined).

**Evidence (as of 20 Apr 2025, all campaigns)**
| Stage | Lost | Rate |
|---|---|---|
| Identified → registered | 825 (425 never started the form, 275 abandoned it, 125 came as walk-ins) | 77.2% convert |
| Registered → confirmed | 300 (183 cancelled, 88 waitlisted, 29 still interested) | 89.3% convert |
| Confirmed → visited | 575 (515 no-show, 60 reached the gate but never admitted) | 77.0% show-up |

- By count, the no-show (515) is the largest leak; by stage rate, identified→registered is the weakest link (22.8% lost).
- Gate losses are small: 50 denied scans, 30 never admitted, 30 left pending/unverified.
- Worst per-campaign leaks: C02 Paid Social (240 no-shows, 180 never started, 100 abandoned) and C03 Creator Partners (115 no-shows, 70 abandoned, 70 never started). C01 Campus Ambassadors accounts for all 60 gate losses.

**Assumptions / limits:** counts are latest status as of the date; walk-ins are a positive, not a leak. Why people no-show isn't in the data — that needs a survey or reminder-contact log.

Want me to check show-up by lead time (how early people registered) to see if late registrants drive the no-shows?
